name: Ledyba
flavour_text: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian

flavour_text: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Shuckle

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Roselia

1.name: Trip Over
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

name: Roserade

1.name: Poison Ring
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

name: Cacnea
flavour_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Cacturne

1.name: Spike Rend
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

name: Chespin
flavour_text: Eating lots of berries makes the bark shell that covers Chespin’s head and body grow sturdier.

name: Quilladin
flavour_text: It can send a trailer flying with a tackle. It’s numb to pain, so even violent collisions don’t faze it.

name: Chesnaught

1.name: Needle Lariat
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack, do 80 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its gentle disposition would have it avoid conflict, but it gives opponents a thrashing with its thorned fists when the situation calls for it.

name: Scatterbug
flavour_text: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

name: Spewpa

1.name: Signs of Evolution
1.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Spewpa from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: Spewpa doesn’t live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

name: Vivillon

1.name: Vivid Powder
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.

flavour_text: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Buzzwole

1.name: Ground Beat
1.effect: If your opponent has gotten exactly 1 point, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Gossifleur
flavour_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss

1.name: Float Up
1.effect: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavour_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

ability.name: Soothing Wind
ability.effect: Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

1.name: Energized Leaves
1.effect: If the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon is 5 or more, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Alolan Marowak

1.name: Fiery Bone
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: The cursed flames that light up the bone carried by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental and physical pain that will never fade.

name: Reshiram

1.name: Blue Flare
1.effect: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

name: Litleo
flavour_text: The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane will grow.

name: Pyroar
flavour_text: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It’s thanks to them that their pride doesn’t starve.

name: Oricorio

1.name: Inspiring Dance
1.effect: During your next turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

1.name: Singe
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

name: Scorbunny
flavour_text: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
flavour_text: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Cinderace

1.name: Fireball Shot
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: Using a ball that it made out of flames, Cinderace blinds its opponents and keeps them at bay.

name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon

1.name: Hearthflame Dance
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, take 2 [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of fire. It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

1.name: Binding Snow
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It’ll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime

1.name: Triple Spin
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Delibird

1.name: Box of Surprises
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. If tails, heal 30 damage from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Marshtomp
flavour_text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert

1.name: Large Whirlpool
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

flavour_text: Swampert’s arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert’s foes. This Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

1.name: Strong-Armed Destroyer
1.effect: Discard 2 random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Vanillite
flavour_text: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
flavour_text: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe

1.name: Sweets Relay
1.effect: If 1 of your Pokémon used Sweets Relay during your last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Cryogonal

1.name: Frozen Lock
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

flavour_text: Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its opponents and then flash-freezes them where they stand.

name: Amaura
flavour_text: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

name: Aurorus

1.name: Hail Prison
1.effect: Discard 2 [W] Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Chewtle
flavour_text: A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: Drednaw
flavour_text: Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them.

name: Cramorant

1.name: Spit-Out Shot

flavour_text: Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda’s frantic thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

name: Arrokuda
flavour_text: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

name: Barraskewda
flavour_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon

1.name: Wellspring Dance
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack also does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of water. It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.

name: Pikachu

1.name: Thunder Jolt
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Alolan Raichu

flavour_text: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

name: Plusle

flavour_text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Toxel

1.name: Damaging Spark

name: Tadbulb

1.effect: Take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

name: Bellibolt

name: Wobbuffet

flavour_text: It can make most any Pokémon run away by opening its big mouth to reveal its thick fangs.

1.name: Psy Turbo

flavour_text: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.

name: Lampent
flavour_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure

name: Indeedee

name: Sandshrew

name: Sandslash

1.name: Fury Swipes

name: Machop

1.effect: Discard a Stadium in play.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp

1.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavour_text: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

name: Cubone
flavour_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Meditite
flavour_text: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

1.effect: If this Pokémon has any [P] Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Roggenrola

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Tyrunt
flavour_text: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum

1.effect: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Passimian

1.name: Fling
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon

1.name: Cornerstone Dance
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −100 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: In this form, it draws on the power of stone. Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all manner of attacks.

name: Alolan Meowth

1.name: Swagger
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Deeply proud and keenly smart, this Pokémon moves with cunning during battle and relentlessly attacks enemies’ weak points.

name: Alolan Persian
flavour_text: This Pokémon is one tough opponent. Not only does it have formidable physical abilities, but it’s also not above fighting dirty.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind of trash, making it a widely used and popular Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.

name: Alolan Muk

ability.name: Power of Alchemy
ability.effect: Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

flavour_text: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavour_text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavour_text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon

1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Stunky
flavour_text: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Skuntank

name: Spiritomb

ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Purrloin

1.name: Whiny Voice
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.

flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard

1.name: Fasten Claws
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
flavour_text: It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty

1.name: Crush the Weak
1.effect: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Yveltal

1.name: Evil Crash
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from both Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Guzzlord

1.name: Breakcore
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker

ability.name: Dig Up
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 random Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

1.effect: Until this Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, this Pokémon's Heat-Up Crunch attack does +30 damage. This effect stacks.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Ferroseed
flavour_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

name: Ferrothorn

1.name: Pummel
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Galarian Stunfisk

1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot when your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, this attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

name: Honedge
flavour_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

name: Doublade

1.name: Dual Blades
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Bagon
flavour_text: Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.

name: Shelgon
flavour_text: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

name: Salamence

1.name: Dragon Dive
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

flavour_text: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: Persian
flavour_text: It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Kangaskhan

1.name: Steady Punch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Sentret

1.name: Tail Rap
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: If it encounters a foe, it will stand up on its tail, making itself look bigger than usual to intimidate them.

name: Furret
flavour_text: It is nimble and has a very flexible body. Even if you get ahold of it, it’ll slip right out of your arms.

name: Smeargle

flavour_text: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.

name: Lugia

1.name: Aeroblast
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

flavour_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Taillow
flavour_text: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow

ability.name: Repelling Wind
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Basic Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

flavour_text: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Slakoth

1.name: Yawn
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth

1.name: Best Punch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.

name: Slaking

name: Spinda

name: Tornadus

1.name: Blow Through
1.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Bunnelby
flavour_text: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

name: Diggersby

1.name: Earthquake
1.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Furfrou

ability.name: Fur Coat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Tandemaus

1.name: Flock
1.effect: Put 3 random cards from among Tandemaus and Maushold from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold

1.name: Family Beatdown
1.effect: Flip a coin for each Tandemaus and Maushold you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Jaw Fossil
card_text: Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic [ C ] Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. This card can't retreat.

name: Lucky Ice Pop
card_text: Heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. If you healed any damage in this way, flip a coin. If heads, put this Lucky Ice Pop into your hand instead of the discard pile.

name: Sail Fossil
card_text: Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic [ C ] Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. This card can't retreat.

name: Metal Core Barrier
card_text: If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your opponent's turn. The [ M ] Pokémon this card is attached to takes −50 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Diantha
card_text: Heal 90 damage from 1 of your [ P ] Pokémon that has 2 or more [ P ] Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard 2 [ P ] Energy from that Pokémon.

name: Sightseer
card_text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put all Stage 1 Pokémon you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Juggler
card_text: You can use this card only if your Pokémon in play have 3 or more different types of Energy attached. Move all Energy from each of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

name: Piers
card_text: You can use this card only if you have Galarian Obstagoon in play. Discard 2 random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Training Area
card_text: Attacks used by Stage 1 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) do +10 damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Starting Plains
card_text: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +20 HP.

name: Peculiar Plaza
card_text: The Retreat Cost of each [ P ] Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is 2 less.

name: Cacnea
flavour_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Roserade

1.name: Poison Ring
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

name: Vivillon

1.name: Vivid Powder
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Asleep.

flavour_text: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Buzzwole

1.name: Ground Beat
1.effect: If your opponent has gotten exactly 1 point, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Reshiram

1.name: Blue Flare
1.effect: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.

name: Oricorio

1.name: Inspiring Dance
1.effect: During your next turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.

name: Scorbunny
flavour_text: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Aurorus

1.name: Hail Prison
1.effect: Discard 2 [W] Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

name: Cramorant

1.name: Spit-Out Shot
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda’s frantic thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.

name: Minun

1.name: Buddy Spark
1.effect: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Toxel
flavour_text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavour_text: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

name: Snubbull
flavour_text: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

name: Indeedee

1.name: Zen Shard
1.effect: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer’s side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.

name: Sandshrew

1.name: Double Scratch
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

name: Tyrantrum

1.name: Tyrannical Fang
1.effect: If you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

name: Falinks

ability.name: Coordinated Unit
ability.effect: If you have another Falinks in play, this Pokémon's attacks do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon, and this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Alolan Muk

ability.name: Power of Alchemy
ability.effect: Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

flavour_text: What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.

name: Purrloin

1.name: Whiny Voice
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.

flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Yveltal

1.name: Evil Crash
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from both Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Galarian Obstagoon

1.name: Merciless Strike
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Galarian Perrserker

ability.name: Dig Up
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 random Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Salamence

1.name: Dragon Dive
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

flavour_text: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: Slakoth

1.name: Yawn
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Meowth

ability.name: Carefree Steps
ability.effect: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

1.name: Feelin’ Fine
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Tangela

1.name: Sleep Powder
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Magby

1.name: Toasty Toss
1.effect: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.

name: Magmar

1.name: Stoke
1.effect: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavour_text: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Mantyke

1.name: Splashy Toss
1.effect: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.

name: Omanyte
flavour_text: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

name: Omastar

1.name: Ancient Whirlpool
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

name: Pichu

1.name: Crackly Toss
1.effect: Take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Basic Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Latias

1.name: Crossing Flights
1.effect: If Latios is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

flavour_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios

ability.name: Fantastical Floating
ability.effect: If you have Latias in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

1.name: Luster Purge
1.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Hitmonlee

1.name: Stretch Kick
1.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

name: Hitmonchan
flavour_text: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

name: Kabuto
flavour_text: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

name: Kabutops

1.name: Leech Life
1.effect: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

name: Phanpy

1.name: Reckless Charge
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Tyrogue
flavour_text: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Tauros

1.name: Fighting Tackle
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

ability.name: Dark Chase
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it to the Active Spot.

1.name: Elemental Blast
1.effect: Discard a [R], [W], and [L] Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Meloetta

ability.name: Strange Singing
ability.effect: At the beginning of your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put a random [P] Pokémon from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
